about: Gwithian Academy of Surfing is a surf school beside a large car park in Gwithian, at the northern end of St Ives Bay near Hayle. It surfs mainly at the National Trust beaches of Gwithian and Godrevy. It runs lessons from first-timer to advanced level, along with surf clubs, school groups and surf holidays that include accommodation.
offers: School, college, stag and hen groups
Surf holidays with accommodation, including 'Silver Surfers' breaks
where: Next to the car park in Gwithian; lessons at Gwithian and Godrevy beaches
goodToKnow: Lessons last two hours, equipment is included and you can keep the kit for an hour afterwards to practise
Bring a swimsuit, towel and sunscreen; changing facilities and a secure kit store are on site
Teaches anyone over 8; younger children may need a private lesson
States it is an ASI-accredited school; coaches are qualified lifeguards and first aiders
season: Open daily; booking in advance is advised in summer
gaps: Cancellation terms not stated; no season dates
